about: SP-055: every Spaces pane action (each method of an OrchKit Spaces*API protocol, the calls the Spaces pane and Settings > Spaces make to orchd) and its CLI equivalent. TestSpacesPaneParity fails when a method has no entry, an entry names no method, or a command or flag does not exist; TestSpacesPaneParityAccess checks 'access' against orchd's D-78 rules. access: anyone = any caller, orchd narrows what it answers; operator = the operator: a terminal with no policy applied, or under a policy Orch.app or a terminal 'orch spaces unlock' unlocked (D-71, D-78); orch-app = under a policy only Orch.app, even in an unlocked terminal (D-78).
